posts.text:
We are Expanding our Developer Network
 If you know Claude Code, n8n, Make, or Lovable — keep reading.

We're scouting developers for two things:
→ Our Venture Studio at nextcallagent.io 
→ Our AI Venture Studio Launch Accelerator

Here's what we care about:

You ship fast with low-code / no-code tools.
You've built real automations and dashboards — not just watched tutorials.
You understand AI workflows, not just prompts.

We don't care about your degree.

We don't care about your job title.

We care about what you've actually built.

Projects range from $3K to $250K.

This is for builders who want in on real ventures — not another freelance gig.

If that's you, APPLY below.
We're reviewing applications this week.

🔗 https://lnkd.in/eWFduDs5

Speaking of Inbreeding...
Haven't heard anything from the openclaw bros in a while. 

Did Hermes win the war?

Did they not end up building a $10M Company off one prompt?

Where did the Mac Minis go?

Is Claude Code that owerpowered?

If you scroll on LinkedIn even for an hour, 
you'll see the amount of horrendous shilling that is going on in this market. 

Random guys in the third world or broccoli heads in Miami
will convince you that one Claude Code prompt can replace your entire staff and their bloodline. 

I even heard Tony Robbins the other day explain how he has an agent that bought him a robot and programmed it for him. 

My genuine advice to you is not to listen to everything, especially stuff that literally sounds too stupid to be true. 

In a world where "New" is automatically assumed to be better, take a chance to look at the old. 

And realize that most of the principles of success from the past 50 years are still being applied today and even at a higher level.

Truly Yours, 
Your Mentor & Friend 

Sam Arami

After consulting 222 agencies and studying over 1,000 offers…
Here are the 50 Niches I'd own if I started from scratch.

Everyone else is fighting over the same 5 broad verticals.

The winners picked a sub-niche nobody else was speaking to.
 and owned it.

So I mapped the 50 best agency sub-niches for 2026.
 
 Not "dentists" → implant clinics filling $30K cases.
 Not "roofers" → commercial re-roofing contracts.
 Not "property managers" → the ones running 50–500 units.

What's inside:
→ 50 specific sub-niches across 8 categories, ranked by demand and budget
 → How to sell each one — the exact pain that closes
 → The channel to reach them: LinkedIn first, cold call as backup
 → The A.I builds that fit each one (voice agents, speed-to-lead, custom CRMs)
 → An 8-point "dream client" scorecard so you pick a client you can scale with

One right sub-niche beats 50 cold leads.

You build the system once, then sell it down the whole vertical.

This isn't a list of industries you already know.

It's the map I wish I had when I started.

1. Comment "NICHE" and I'll send you the full guide.
2. Repost to skip the line 🔁
The Simple answers I wish I knew at the start

This is the best A.I offer to sell in 2026.
You'd have to be a moron to sell anything else:

A.I Pay-Per-Lead on the front end.
A.I Venture Studio on the backend.

Let's be honest about what everyone else is doing.

Selling $500/mo retainers that die in 3 months.

Slapping a GoHighLevel snapshot on a dentist and calling it "A.I."

Building a voice bot that sounds like a fax machine having a stroke.

That's not a business. 

That's a job with worse hours and a boss who fires you in 90 days.

Here's the offer that actually prints:

Front end: Pay-Per-Lead. Zero risk to the buyer. They pay per qualified lead.

You're in the door in days.

Then you let it run.

15 days in, the leads are stacking up. 

Your infrastructure just proved itself inside their business.

Now you earn the real discovery call. The one they'd never book cold.

And you point at every broken thing the leads just exposed:

→ Their website converts like a wet napkin. You rebuild it. $5K.
→ They can't handle the volume you created. Voice agent, 24/7. $10K.
→ Their follow-up leaks money everywhere. Full funnel install. $20K.
→ They want it all wired together. You build the operating system. $50K+.

You never cold pitched once.

The leads did the selling for you.

Agencies sell one service and beg for a renewal.

You prove it, then sell the next problem on repeat.
